Donor aldehyde and alcohol cells test attachment and scaffold transfer, while carbonyl and ester cells separate onset from completion responses. m149, m184, and m5 provide compact heavy atom controls. This mixture should improve Row distribution generalization by teaching the retrained QGeoGNN where interactions and thresholds are required and where local corrections must remain suppressed."}
